summary: Two reproducible status-consistency omissions; offline tests pass and authority boundary claims match implementation.

findings.rationale: Only accepted optimisation decisions receive lifecycle consistency checks. A complete handoff with decision incomplete and correctness not_run is accepted despite explicitly reporting unresolved work. This can prematurely mark a procedure complete in downstream status displays; no authority escalation is alleged.
findings.reproduction: python3 -m agentkit validate /private/tmp/agentkit-toolkit-review/probe-complete-optimisation-incomplete.json returns 0 and status complete. Require complete optimisation to use a terminal decision; preserve valid completed rejection with failed correctness.

findings.rationale: A complete review with verdict findings and an empty findings array validates. The reverse contradiction is rejected, but this direction is omitted, leaving no actionable finding for a reported findings verdict.
findings.reproduction: python3 -m agentkit validate /private/tmp/agentkit-toolkit-review/probe-findings-verdict-empty.json returns 0. Require a findings verdict to contain at least one finding.
